descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S05 「现成 spec：别处做的添加、删除和修改会到达开着的医院列表，另一个医生的病人永远不会」 Existing specs: an add, a delete and an edit made elsewhere reach an open Hospital list, and another physician's patient never does

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 A patient added on the phone appears on the computer in real time, with no refresh or re-entry.（UAT TC-25 step 2；UAT TC-25；TFA-94704 AC 5；TFA-94513 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U5 A patient deleted on the computer disappears from the phone in real time.（UAT TC-25 step 5；UAT TC-25；TFA-94513 AC 18；TFA-94704 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • T2 Edits made on one device (not only add, generate and delete) show on the other in real time, with no refresh.（TFA-94704 AC 5；TFA-94513 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Hospital list open in the browser; for 'two open sessions stay in step' a second context from the same storageState sits on the chart; for isolation a second physician owns a patient

When rounding:add, a delete and rounding:update (room 4B-01 -> 7C-14, and 2A-02 -> 9F-09) through the API with the same account; the other physician's patient is looked for on the list and opened by URL

Then Each change shows on the open list without a reload (the new card, the card gone, the new room and not the old one); the other physician's patient is not on the list and its URL does not open it

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions in e2e/reactivity.spec.ts (within Playwright's default 5 s expect timeout) and e2e/isolation.spec.ts. Evidence for the Hospital propagation only: the other 'device' is the same session token (not evidence for T1), the add does not go through the phone's form, Nursing Home is not covered (S01, S02, S09), and the chart context is not asserted after the chan …

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S05 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-25.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
